r3-xsplit TEST RESULTS (2026-11-08). Everything below was actually run; nothing here ran on a GPU.

== Not run (needs a stopped node, lead's window) ==
device_test.py (bitwise vs live JIT kernel: normal + 6 hostile classes, poisoned workspace, stale epochs,
grids 1..64, SM-hogging co-runner, l2pf stand-in, epoch wrap, 256 graph replays, exact bench variants, gate
phase with the flag on) and bench/xsplit_bench.py (S0 / c / barrier / write-back / B / rope / prefetch costs,
step model). No exactness or timing claim about the real kernel on hardware is made until they run.

SASS CHECK PASS

(a0r0 and a0r1p0 bench variants: FP32 ops without .FTZ: 0, SASS CHECK PASS.)
Reading: C0 = the live kernel instantiated in the bench library is the production JIT kernel instruction for
instruction (so the bench's "live" arm and device_test's in-library reference are the production kernel). FFMA.FTZ
15 = 14 replay FFMAs (acc_o live row) + 1 sink FFMA (live 29 = 28 + 1: no new FFMA anywhere, i.e. the A unit did
not contract qk*scale - nm and the l replay is not an FFMA). HMMA 36 = 28 QK nope + 4 QK rope + 4 rope XV (live 40
has the rope-XV block twice, main/extra). The B guard compiles to the live form: FMNMX.FTZ(min alpha0,alpha1) +
FSETP.GEU.FTZ ..., 1. Workspace loads are LDG.E.STRONG.GPU / LDG.E.64.STRONG.GPU (acquire, .cg), with CCTL.IVALL;
.CONSTANT loads are only on read-only inputs.
